## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Add the required verification section to the pull-request description; its absence violates repository policy.

## Changes
Adds an ASCII slug helper that lowercases titles, replaces separator runs with hyphens, and trims surrounding hyphens. Parameterized tests cover capitalization, repeated separators, and empty results.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- PR body — correctness — Add the required Testing section — The description omits verification details, violating AGENTS.md:4: “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers lack the verification account required by the repository’s contribution policy.

## Suggestions
- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Cover numeric titles in the slug tests — For `"123"`, no test checks that digits survive slugification. The regex explicitly accepts digits, but neither the added examples nor the existing import test exercises that path. — A regression that removes digits could pass the current suite while producing empty slugs for numeric page titles.
